name: Agentic Security
description: Agentic-Security is a powerful Claude Code plugin that automatically performs Application Security Testing (SAST, SCA, secrets detection, and more). Think of it as the easy button for making your Claude-generated code safe and secure.
longDescription:
Ships **7 skills**, **10 agents**, **10 commands**, **5 hooks** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (7): `add-scan-rule` (Walk through the six-step recipe for adding a new SAST detector — pick the module, export scan*(), wire,…), `privacy-data-flow` (Privacy review before handling user data), `secure-coding-guard` (Guard risky writes), `security-explain` (Explain or teach a vuln), `security-fix-finding` (Apply a remediation patch via the deterministic MCP toolchain), `security-rotate-leak` (Rotate a leaked secret end-to-end), `security-scan-on-deploy` (Run the security scanner)
- **Agents** (10): `_CONFINEMENT`, `refactor-cleaner` (Safely apply dead-code cleanup batches identified by /trim-dead-code), `sca-malware-analyst` (Per-component CLEAN/SUSPICIOUS/MALICIOUS verdict for third-party dependencies), `sca-triager` (Emit a structured per-vulnerable_dep verdict (AUTO_MERGE_PATCH | WAIT_FOR_PATCH | MANUAL_REVIEW | ACCEPT_RISK | WONT_FIX) from composite risk +…), `security-chain-synthesizer` (Combine individual security findings into multi-step attack chains (e.g., IDOR + missing auth = account takeover)), `security-fixer` (Apply remediation patches for individual security findings from /security-scan), `security-logic-reviewer` (Read route handlers and find business-logic flaws that pattern matchers miss — broken authorization tier checks, missing negative…), `security-material-change` (Score the security materiality of a git diff (or a PR's changes)), and 2 more
- **Commands** (10): `compliance` (Compliance + auditor flows), `find-and-fix-everything` (Full /scan --all then /fix --all --low in one command), `fix` (Remediate findings: --one <id>, --all by severity, --pr bundles a PR, --sca upgrades vulnerable deps), `labs` (Experimental + AI-driven), `posture` (Posture + reporting), `scan` (Run the scanner), `secure` (Security router — inspects project state and routes to the single best next action), `setup` (Workflow installers + on-write guards), and 2 more
- **Hooks** (5): `SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`
- **MCP servers** (1): `agentic-security`

Installs with `claude plugin install agentic-security@claude-community` from `Clear-Capabilities/agentic-security`.
